address_pairs.speaker: 아미르

continuity: Amir and Hamid lead fanatics who have begun advancing toward their promised land, believing the time promised by the Prophet and Allah has arrived.
The Prophet and the S-rank monsters have not appeared in the battle; an immense surge of magical power approaches from far away.
plot: In the desert, Amir and Hamid’s fanatics kill an A-rank Hunter and his remaining men, then begin advancing toward the promised land at the time the Prophet foretold.

Jin Taekyung and the Hunters hold formation against the monster army. Taekyung fights with White Flame and daggers, imitating the Slaughter Saint’s Ghost Illusory Slaughter Step, while the Skeleton King’s undead buy time for the Hunters’ attacks. The Prophet and the S-rank monsters remain unseen, and a tremendous surge of magical power begins to shake the desert.
translation_decisions: Keep magical power distinct from mana.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung is the World Hunter Federation’s Alliance Leader and pursues Main Quest [Cataclysm], which requires him to eliminate The Prophet within an unspecified time limit.
Jin’s force is fighting a monster army of more than ten thousand in the Rub’ al Khali; he orders the Hunters to hold formation and minimize losses.
The Prophet and the S-rank monsters remain unseen as the battle unfolds.
The Skeleton King’s undead fight the monsters and can raise fallen monsters as soldiers, but their existence is limited by the magical power he bestowed.
Amir and Hamid lead desert fanatics who have begun advancing toward their promised land, believing the time foretold by the Prophet has arrived.
A distant, immense surge of magical power is shaking the desert.
open_questions: Where are The Prophet and the S-rank monsters, and when will they enter the battle?
What is causing the immense magical-power surge?
Are Amir’s fanatics the non-monster enemy that attacked Chuck Hagel’s search party, and what is their intended target?
temporary_decisions: Keep magical power distinct from mana.

names.notes: The elder identified by name in the opening scene; addressed as Amir.

profile_creations.personality: Religiously fervent, resolute, and convinced that the Prophet’s promised time has arrived.
profile_creations.relationships: He leads Hamid and the fanatics, who follow his command and revere the Prophet and Allah.
profile_creations.role: Elder leader of the desert fanatics who commands Hamid and leads his followers toward the promised land.
profile_creations.voice: Calm and authoritative, framing his commands and convictions in religious terms.
